title: Preview reels
description: Optional image and video trailers that play as a carousel on Library cards when someone hovers or swipes.
content:
A preview reel is a short trailer for your hub. On Library, it shows as a carousel when someone hovers or swipes the card, so they can sample the hub before they open it.

Primary action: Open a hub you own → Hub settings → Preview reel

What it is

Preview reels are optional. They do not replace a cover image, title, or description. They give Library visitors a few clips: images or short videos: before they decide to open or buy.

Limits

  • Up to eight clips per hub
  • Images or video (MP4 or WebM)
  • Videos should stay around 30 seconds or less
  • You can upload a new clip or pick a file already in the hub

How to add one

  1. Open the hub and go to settings.
  2. Open the Preview reel studio.
  3. Add clips. Put the strongest trailer first: that is what people see first on the card.
  4. For images, you can reposition the crop so the important part stays in the carousel frame.
  5. Save. Check the listing preview before you list the hub on Library.

How visitors see it

  • Desktop: hover a Library card.
  • Touch: swipe the card preview.

If a hub has no reel, the cover image is what people see.

Tips

  • Lead with a clip that shows the actual work: a page, a slide, a short clip from the session: not only a logo.
  • Keep motion calm. This is a sample, not an ad bumper.
  • If you monetize, match the reel to what buyers get after checkout.
